scripts.build: bun run s11tnext:check && tsc && vite build
scripts.test:frontend: bun run s11tnext:check && bun test tests
scripts.test: bun run test:frontend && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: bun run s11tnext:check && bun run typecheck && cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun run test
scripts.spec:check: bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs --warnings-as-errors && bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs/.archived --fixer --format
scripts.spec:fix: bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs --fix --warnings-as-errors && bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs/.archived --fixer --format --fix
